单击空白处取消选择；按住左键拖动才出现选框，松手完成。白色实线为左→右包含选，白: Click empty space to deselect; hold Left-Click and drag to box-select, release to confirm. Solid white line (Left→Right) is Window select; dashed white line (Right→Left) is Crossing select. Standard box replaces selection, Ctrl adds, Shift removes (click or box). Esc or Right-Click during drag cancels the box and keeps current selection; Esc when idle clears selection. To use hot grips, select a point or sketch line, then click and release a blue grip to turn it red. Move the cursor to preview, then click a target or type a value and press Enter. Endpoints default to Stretch and midpoints to Move; press empty Enter/Space to cycle Stretch, Move, Rotate, Scale, and Mirror. Enter angle for Rotate, factor for Scale, or axis angle for Mirror. Esc or Ctrl+Z cancels the active grip while keeping selection; press Ctrl+Z again to undo committed edits. Dragging grips directly is also supported.
